NEW finding (run-5). The customer-screen console emits 8x 'The AudioContext was not allowed to start. It must be resumed (or created) after a user gesture on the page' warnings. This is the order-ready notification chime attempting to autoplay before any user gesture on the public OSS screen. The chime is silent until first interaction. Cosmetic in test context but in production a customer-facing screen never receives a tap (it is a passive display) — the chime feature will NEVER fire as designed. Functional regression hidden behind a benign-looking warning.
findings.fix_hint: Strategy 1: Replace the AudioContext-based chime with an HTMLAudioElement preloaded with `audio.muted = true; audio.play()` then unmute on first network event (Pusher tick). Strategy 2: Trigger an initial user-gesture-equivalent via `requestUserActivation()` polyfill, OR document that the chime requires a one-time admin-tap on screen mount. Add a Playwright assertion that `customer-screen.audio.play()` resolves without DOMException on the test fixture.
